title: Your Bank Earns $3,400 on Your Money — You Get $12
hook: Your bank isn't holding your money — it's lending it out at 7% while paying you 0.03%, and pocketing the difference.
angle: Most 'move to a HYSA' videos focus on interest rates. This one exposes the hidden bank profit machine — the net interest margin — and shows exactly how much your bank earns from your money each year.
audience: Anyone with savings at a big bank (Chase, BofA, Wells Fargo) who hasn't moved to a high-yield account
key_numbers: 3.3% net interest margin = $1,373/year for the bank
